4.  **Modal "Responsive":**
    *   Ahora tiene scroll interno para asegurar que, si usas el teclado del celular en modo horizontal, puedas ver todos los campos y el botón de "Guardar".

const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showPolicy, setShowPolicy] = useState(false); // State for Policy Modal
  
  const [movies, setMovies] = useState<Movie[]>(INITIAL_MOVIES);
  const [viewState, setViewState] = useState<ViewState>(ViewState.HOME);
  const [currentMovie, setCurrentMovie] = useState<Movie | null>(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  
  const [myListIds, setMyListIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [likedMovieIds, setLikedMovieIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Check policy status when App mounts (but doesn't interfere with splash yet)
  useEffect(() => {
     // We can prepare this value, but we only use it after splash finishes
  }, []);

  const handleSplashFinish = () => {
    setLoading(false);
    // Check local storage for policy acceptance
    const accepted = localStorage.getItem('samstudios_policy_accepted');
    if (!accepted) {
      setShowPolicy(true);
    }
  };

  const handlePolicyAccept = () => {
    localStorage.setItem('samstudios_policy_accepted', 'true');
    setShowPolicy(false);
  };

  const toggleMyList = (movieId: string) => {
    setMyListIds(prev => 
      prev.includes(movieId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== movieId) : [...prev, movieId]
    );
  };

  const toggleLike = (movieId: string) => {
    setLikedMovieIds(prev => 
      prev.includes(movieId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== movieId) : [...prev, movieId]
    );
  };

  const filteredMovies = useMemo(() => {
    const sourceMovies = viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST 
      ? movies.filter(m => myListIds.includes(m.id)) 
      : movies;

    return sourceMovies.filter(m => 
      m.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
      m.genre.some(g => g.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()))
    );
  }, [movies, searchTerm, viewState, myListIds]);

  const moviesByGenre = useMemo(() => {
    const getMatches = (keywords: string[]) => 
      movies.filter(m => m.genre.some(g => keywords.some(k => g.toLowerCase().includes(k.toLowerCase()))));
    
    const categories: Record<string, Movie[]> = {
      'Estrenos y Novedades': movies.filter(m => m.year === '2025' || m.year === '2026' || m.year === '2024'), // Added 2024 for Dune 2
      'Romance y K-Dramas': getMatches(['Romance', 'K-Drama', 'Dorama']),
      'Series de TV': getMatches(['Serie']),
      'Miedo y Suspenso': getMatches(['Terror', 'Horror', 'Suspenso', 'Thriller']),
      'Ciencia Ficción': getMatches(['Sci-Fi', 'Ciencia', 'Fantasía']),
      'Acción y Aventura': getMatches(['Acción', 'Action', 'Aventura']),
      'Animación y Familia': getMatches(['Animación', 'Familia', 'Comedia']),
    };

    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(categories).filter(([_, list]) => list.length > 0));
  }, [movies]);

  const trendingMovies = useMemo(() => {
    const priorityTitles = [
        "Gladiador II",         // #1 Priority
        "Dune",                 // #2 
        "Study Group",          // #3
        "Baby",                 // #4 
        "Weak Hero Class 2",    // #5
        "Destino Final",        // #6
        "Stranger Things",      // #7
        "Culpa Nuestra",        // #8
        "Euphoria",             // #9
        "Los Ilusionistas 3",   // #10
        "Adolescencia",         // #11
        "Gran Diluvio",         // #12
    ];

    const trends: Movie[] = [];
    const others: Movie[] = [];

    movies.forEach(m => {
        if (priorityTitles.some(pt => m.title.includes(pt))) {
            trends.push(m);
        } else {
            others.push(m);
        }
    });

    trends.sort((a, b) => {
        const indexA = priorityTitles.findIndex(pt => a.title.includes(pt));
        const indexB = priorityTitles.findIndex(pt => b.title.includes(pt));
        return indexA - indexB;
    });

    return [...trends, ...others].slice(0, 10);
  }, [movies]);

  const myListMovies = useMemo(() => movies.filter(m => myListIds.includes(m.id)), [movies, myListIds]);

  const handleAddMovie = (movie: Movie) => {
    setMovies(prev => [movie, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleMovieClick = (movie: Movie) => {
    setCurrentMovie(movie);
    setViewState(ViewState.PLAYER);
  };

  const handleBackToHome = () => {
    setCurrentMovie(null);
    setViewState(ViewState.HOME);
  };

  const heroMovie = trendingMovies[0];

  // 1. Show Splash Screen
  if (loading) {
    return <SplashScreen onFinish={handleSplashFinish} />;
  }

  // 2. Show Policy Modal (only if not seen before)
  if (showPolicy) {
      return <DisclaimerModal onAccept={handlePolicyAccept} />;
  }

  // 3. Main App
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050505] text-[#e5e5e5] font-sans selection:bg-white selection:text-black pb-20 overflow-x-hidden animate-fade-in">
      {/* Detail View */}
      {viewState === ViewState.PLAYER && currentMovie ? (
        <Player 
          movie={currentMovie}
          allMovies={movies}
          onBack={handleBackToHome}
          onMovieClick={handleMovieClick}
          isLiked={likedMovieIds.includes(currentMovie.id)}
          isInMyList={myListIds.includes(currentMovie.id)}
          onToggleLike={() => toggleLike(currentMovie.id)}
          onToggleMyList={() => toggleMyList(currentMovie.id)}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <Navbar 
            onAddClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
            onHomeClick={() => setViewState(ViewState.HOME)}
            onMyListClick={() => setViewState(ViewState.MY_LIST)}
            searchTerm={searchTerm}
            onSearchChange={setSearchTerm}
          />

          <main>
            
            {/* Hero Section - Reduced height for mobile */}
            {viewState === ViewState.HOME && !searchTerm && heroMovie && (
              <div className="relative w-full h-[55vh] md:h-[95vh]">
                 {/* Background */}
                 <div className="absolute inset-0">
                    <img 
                        src={heroMovie.posterUrl} 
                        alt="Hero Cover"
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover object-top mask-image-gradient"
                    />
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/40 to-transparent" />
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/10 to-transparent" />
                    <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-40 md:h-64 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/90 to-transparent" />
                 </div>

                 {/* Hero Text Content */}
                 <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-end md:items-center pb-12 md:pb-0">
                    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 w-full">
                        <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-2 md:space-y-6 animate-fade-in-up">
                             <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 border border-white/30 rounded text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white/80 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md">
                                    Nº 1 en Tendencias
                                </span>
                             </div>
                            
                            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl font-black text-white leading-none tracking-tighter drop-shadow-2xl">
                                {heroMovie.title}
                            </h1>
                            
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs md:text-sm font-medium text-gray-300">
                                <span className="text-green-400 font-bold">99% Match</span>
                                <span>{heroMovie.year}</span>
                                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-white/10 rounded text-[10px] md:text-xs border border-white/10">HD</span>
                                <span>{heroMovie.genre[0]}</span>
                            </div>

                            <p className="text-gray-200 text-sm md:text-xl line-clamp-2 md:line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed drop-shadow-md max-w-2xl font-light hidden sm:block">
                                {heroMovie.description}
                            </p>
                            
                            <div className="flex flex-row items-center gap-3 pt-2">
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => handleMovieClick(heroMovie)}
                                    className="flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-2 md:px-8 md:py-3.5 bg-white text-black font-bold text-sm md:text-lg rounded hover:bg-gray-200 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.15)]"
                                >
                                    <Play className="h-4 w-4 md:h-6 md:w-6 mr-2 fill-black" />
                                    Reproducir
                                </button>
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => handleMovieClick(heroMovie)}
                                    className="flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-2 md:px-8 md:py-3.5 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white font-bold text-sm md:text-lg rounded transition-colors backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95"
                                >
                                    <Info className="h-4 w-4 md:h-6 md:w-6 mr-2" />
                                    Más Info
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                 </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Content Rows */}
            <div className={`relative z-10 w-full ${viewState === ViewState.HOME && !searchTerm ? '-mt-6 md:-mt-48' : 'pt-24 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8'}`}>
                
                {viewState === ViewState.HOME && !searchTerm ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 md:gap-10 pb-20">
                         {/* Trending */}
                         {trendingMovies.length > 0 && (
                            <MovieRow title="Tendencias de hoy" movies={trendingMovies} onMovieClick={handleMovieClick} rank />
                         )}

                         {/* NEW: Top 10 Actors Section */}
                         <TopActorsRow />

                         {/* My List */}
                         {myListMovies.length > 0 && (
                            <MovieRow title="Mi Lista" movies={myListMovies} onMovieClick={handleMovieClick} />
                         )}
                         
                         {/* Categories */}
                         {Object.entries(moviesByGenre).map(([title, categoryMovies]) => (
                            <MovieRow 
                                key={title} 
                                title={title} 
                                movies={categoryMovies} 
                                onMovieClick={handleMovieClick} 
                            />
                         ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                
                /* Grid View (Search or My List) */
                <>
                    <div className="mb-6 flex items-end justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
                        <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                             {viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST && <Plus className="h-5 w-5 md:h-6 md:w-6 text-brand-500"/>}
                             {searchTerm && <Search className="h-5 w-5 md:h-6 md:w-6 text-brand-500"/>}
                            {searchTerm 
                                ? `Resultados: "${searchTerm}"` 
                                : viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST 
                                    ? 'Mi Lista' 
                                    : 'Catálogo'}
                        </h2>
                    </div>

                    {filteredMovies.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2 sm:gap-4 md:gap-6">
                        {filteredMovies.map(movie => (
                        <MovieCard key={movie.id} movie={movie} onClick={handleMovieClick} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    ) : (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-32 text-gray-500 text-center px-4">
                        <div className="bg-white/5 p-8 rounded-full mb-6 border border-white/5">
                            {viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST ? (
                                <Plus className="h-12 w-12 text-gray-400" />
                            ) : (
                                <Search className="h-12 w-12 text-gray-400" />
                            )}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xl font-medium text-gray-300">
                            {viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST 
                                ? "Tu lista está vacía."
                                : `No encontramos nada para "${searchTerm}"`}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-2 max-w-xs">
                             {viewState === ViewState.MY_LIST 
                                ? "Agrega películas y series para verlas más tarde."
                                : "Intenta con otro título o género."}
                        </p>

Es una excelente pregunta técnica. La respuesta corta es: **técnicamente sí se puede, pero en la práctica la mayoría de las webs no te dejarán.**

Aquí te explico los detalles como ingeniero:

1.  **El problema del bloqueo (X-Frame-Options):** La mayoría de las páginas web modernas (especialmente las de streaming) envían una instrucción de seguridad al navegador llamada `X-Frame-Options: DENY` o `SAMEORIGIN`. Esto le dice al navegador: *"No permitas que nadie me meta dentro de un iframe"*. Si intentas cargar la página entera, lo más probable es que veas un cuadro gris que dice **"Conexión rechazada"**.
2.  **Seguridad y Pop-ups:** Las webs de películas gratis suelen estar llenas de scripts de publicidad y redirecciones. Si logras meterlas en un iframe, esos anuncios podrían intentar "romper" el iframe y tomar control de tu pestaña principal o llenar de basura la experiencia del usuario.
3.  **La solución ideal (Embeds):** Lo que sí funciona perfectamente son los links de **reproductor directo (Embed)**. Muchas de estas webs ofrecen un link específico para integradores (como los que usa Cuevana). Esos links están diseñados para ser usados en iframes y solo muestran el video, sin toda la web de alrededor.

**En resumen:** Si intentas abrir la *página completa*, el 90% de las veces fallará por seguridad del navegador. Lo más profesional es seguir usando links directos al video (embeds) que sí permiten iframes.
